cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Places in a town; each picture shows one clear place.

words.en: We live in a small town.
words.scene: A small town with houses, a church and a river.
more: The town has a big market.
这个城镇有一个大市场。
Grandpa lives in the next town.
爷爷住在邻近的城镇。

words.en: Dad works in the city centre.
words.scene: A busy city centre with tall buildings, shops and people.
more: We take a bus to the city centre.
我们坐公共汽车去市中心。
The city centre is very busy on Saturdays.
星期六的市中心非常繁忙。

words.en: Lily runs in the town square.
words.scene: A town square with a fountain and pigeons.
more: The window is a big square.
窗户是一个大方块。
We meet in the square after school.
放学后我们在广场见面。

words.en: Mum buys fruit at the market.
words.scene: A busy outdoor market with fruit and vegetable stalls.
more: The market opens on Sunday morning.
市场在星期天上午开门。
We walk to the market every week.
我们每周都走去市场。

words.en: The shop is on the corner.
words.scene: A café on the corner of two streets.
more: Tom sits in the corner of the room.
Tom 坐在房间的角落里。
Look at the corner of the page.
看这一页的角落。

words.en: We cross the street here.
words.scene: a busy town street with shops on both sides
more: Our house is on a quiet street.
我们的房子在一条安静的街道上。
The street is full of cars.
街道上满是汽车。

words.en: The car goes down the road.
words.scene: A country road going between green fields, the family car driving along it and Lily looking out of the window
more: Be careful when you cross the road.
过马路时要小心。
The road to Grandma's house is long.
去奶奶家的路很长。

words.en: The train goes over the bridge.
words.scene: A long stone bridge over a wide river, a green train going across it, Lily watching from the grass
more: We walk across the old bridge.
我们走过那座旧桥。
The bridge is very tall.
这座桥很高。

words.en: Lily plays in the park.
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Sam playing football on the green grass of a park, big trees and a duck pond behind them, Max running after the ball.
more: We have a picnic in the park.
我们在公园里野餐。
The ducks swim on the lake in the park.
鸭子在公园的湖里游泳。

words.en: Dad parks the car.
words.scene: Dad parking the family car carefully in a parking space outside a shop, reversing between white lines, Lily and Mum waiting on the pavement.
more: Can you park here?
你可以把车停在这里吗？
Please do not park on the grass.
请不要把车停在草地上。

words.en: Tom plays in the playground.
words.scene: Tom on the slide in a playground, Lily on the swings.
more: We meet at the playground after school.
放学后我们在游乐场见面。
The playground is big and fun.
这个游乐场又大又有趣。

words.en: We see pandas at the zoo.
more: Mum takes Tom to the zoo.
妈妈带 Tom 去动物园。
The zoo is far from our house.
动物园离我们家很远。

words.en: Dad drives into the car park.
words.scene: a car park full of cars in rows.
more: The car park is very busy today.
今天停车场很繁忙。
We leave the car in the car park.
我们把车留在停车场里。

words.en: We wait for the train at the station.
words.scene: a big old railway station building with a clock.
more: The station is near our school.
火车站在我们学校附近。
Dad buys tickets at the station.
爸爸在火车站买票。

words.en: We wait for the bus at the bus station.
words.sz: 我们在公共汽车站等车。
words.scene: a big bus station building with many buses parked in rows.
more: The bus station is very busy in the morning.
公共汽车站在早上很繁忙。
Lily runs to the bus station.
Lily 跑向公共汽车站。

words.en: Mum waits at the bus stop.
words.sz: 妈妈在公共汽车站点等车。
words.scene: Lily and Mum waiting at a bus stop pole by the road, no bus there yet.
more: The bus stop is just around the corner.
公共汽车站点就在拐角处。
We walk to the bus stop every day.
我们每天步行去公共汽车站点。

words.en: We take the underground to school.
words.scene: an underground train arriving in a station under the city.
more: The underground is fast and clean.
地铁又快又干净。
We wait on the underground platform.
我们在地铁月台等车。

words.en: Dad stops at the petrol station.
words.scene: A petrol station at the side of a road, Dad standing beside the family car filling it with petrol from a green pump, a small shop behind.
more: We buy drinks at the petrol station.
我们在加油站买饮料。
Dad fills the car at the petrol station.
爸爸在加油站给车加油。

words.en: We drive on the motorway.
words.sz: 我们在高速公路上开车。
words.scene: a wide motorway with many lanes of cars, seen from a bridge
more: The motorway is very busy today.
今天高速公路很繁忙。
We take the next exit on the motorway.
我们在高速公路上走下一个出口。

words.en: Dad drives round the roundabout.
words.scene: cars driving round a roundabout with flowers in the middle, seen from above
more: Be careful at the roundabout.
在环岛处要小心。
There are many cars on the roundabout.
环岛上有很多车。

words.en: We go to the airport.
words.scene: A modern airport building with big glass windows, a passenger plane on the ground in front of it, and Lily pulling a suitcase towards the door with Dad.
more: The airport is far from home.
机场离家很远。
We look at the plane at the airport.
我们在机场看飞机。
